# temps_project_compose_security (Resource)

Compose file checks Temps skips for a project (by default every check runs and a failing file is refused). Turning a check off needs `acknowledge_risks = true`. Destroying the resource leaves the policy as it is.

Import with `<project_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_project_compose_security" "stack" {
  project_id        = temps_project.stack.id
  disabled_checks   = ["published_ports"]
  acknowledge_risks = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disabled_checks` (Set of String) Checks to skip, for example `bind_mounts` or `published_ports`.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `acknowledge_legacy_migration` (Boolean) Confirm replacing a policy saved by an older Temps. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `acknowledge_risks` (Boolean) Confirm the consequences of the checks turned off. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>
terraform import temps_project_compose_security.stack 8
```
